description: The single object load_run_report assembles for the Analysis Detail UI page.
signature:
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RunReport:
    run_id: str
    run: RunRecord
    stages: list[RunStage]
    missing_stages: list[str]
    opportunity_matrix: pd.DataFrame
    tag_summary: pd.DataFrame
    tag_trends: pd.DataFrame
    case_studies: list[CaseStudy]
    funnel: FunnelSummary
    headline_metrics: dict[str, Any]
    caveats: list[Caveat]
    is_partial: bool
docstring:
Everything the Analysis Detail page needs for one run.

Attributes:
    run: storage.RunRecord for context (status, timestamps, config snapshot).
    stages: storage.read_run_stages(conn, run_id) verbatim, in pipeline order.
    missing_stages: the subset of ('acquisition', 'enrichment', 'analysis') absent from stages or not status='succeeded' in stages, in pipeline order. Empty when the run succeeded cleanly. This is what render_analysis_detail_page and partial_run_caveat name explicitly in the UI (ui module spec edge case 'detail page opened for a run that is still running -> ... with the missing stages named').
    opportunity_matrix, tag_summary, tag_trends: build_opportunity_matrix_view / build_tag_summary_table output and the raw tag_trends analysis_results payload respectively (tag_trends is not separately view-formatted by a dedicated public function in the current module spec -- reused directly here, display-rounding applied inline).
    case_studies: select_case_studies' output (CaseStudySelection.case_studies, already unwrapped).
    funnel: FunnelSummary.
    headline_metrics: headline_metrics(self) -- see that function's own spec; included as a field for convenience so a caller needing only the summary does not have to call a second function.
    caveats: interpretive_caveats(), plus one appended Caveat(key='archetype_cap_relaxed') when select_case_studies' CaseStudySelection.archetype_cap_relaxed was True for this run.
    is_partial: is_partial_run(stages) -- ADR-016's single canonical definition, derived from stages, never from run.status alone, since run.status can lag behind per-stage detail for a partially-completed run.
postconditions: is_partial == bool(missing_stages) -- the two fields are never inconsistent with each other
missing_stages preserves pipeline order (acquisition, enrichment, analysis), never insertion or attempt order
Every DataFrame field is well-formed (correct columns) even when empty, never a bare empty DataFrame with no column information

edge_cases.input: A run with status='running' polled mid-pipeline, acquisition succeeded, enrichment not yet begun
edge_cases.expected_behavior: is_partial=True; missing_stages=['enrichment', 'analysis']; frames reflect whatever analysis_results rows exist so far (possibly all empty)

edge_cases.input: A run with status='failed' partway through enrichment
edge_cases.expected_behavior: is_partial=True; missing_stages=['enrichment', 'analysis'] (a stage whose own run_stages row is 'failed' counts as missing, per missing_stages' definition, distinct from a stage that simply never started); run.error_message is accessible via the run field

edge_cases.input: A run where storage.read_run_stages returns zero rows at all (crashed before any begin_run_stage call)

unit_tests.name: test_succeeded_run_not_partial
unit_tests.description: A fully succeeded fixture run has is_partial=False and missing_stages=[].

unit_tests.name: test_running_run_is_partial
unit_tests.description: A run with status='running' and only acquisition succeeded has is_partial=True and missing_stages=['enrichment', 'analysis'].
